\section[o medo]{o medo — fear}

\label{lesson:PT-C36-medo}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Portuguese for tiredness, then the Portuguese for joy.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: o medo}
\textbf{o medo} — \textquotedblleft{}fear\textquotedblright{}. \textbf{tenho medo}: I am afraid.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{medo} $\leftarrow$ Latin \emph{metus}, \textquotedblleft{}fear\textquotedblright{} (EtymDB 2.1) — inherited. The Latin \emph{-t-} between vowels became \emph{-d-}.
\end{cousinweb}

\textbf{a raiva} — \textquotedblleft{}anger\textquotedblright{}.
